description: This file defines an abstract factory class for managing add-ons in the AnySoftKeyboard project. It handles loading, enabling/disabling, ordering, and external integration of add-ons, including parsing XML configurations and managing shared preferences.

classes.name: AddOnsFactory
classes.description: An abstract generic factory class for managing add-ons, including loading, enabling/disabling, ordering, and handling external add-on packages.

classes.name: AddOnsFactory.AddOnsComparator
classes.description: Comparator class for sorting add-ons, prioritizing the main package and then by sort index.

classes.name: AddOnsFactory.SingleAddOnsFactory
classes.description: A subclass for managing a single add-on at a time, with logic for enabling/disabling and default handling.

classes.name: AddOnsFactory.MultipleAddOnsFactory
classes.description: A subclass for managing multiple add-ons with ordering capabilities.

methods.name: AddOnsFactory.getEnabledAddOns
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of currently enabled add-ons.

methods.name: AddOnsFactory.isAddOnEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific add-on is enabled based on shared preferences.

methods.name: AddOnsFactory.setAddOnEnabled
methods.description: Abstract method to enable or disable an add-on by ID.

methods.name: AddOnsFactory.getAddOnById
methods.description: Retrieves an add-on by its ID, loading add-ons if necessary.

methods.name: AddOnsFactory.getAllAddOns
methods.description: Returns a list of all add-ons, loading them if not already loaded.

methods.name: AddOnsFactory.loadAddOns
methods.description: Loads built-in and external add-ons, parsing XML configurations and managing order.

methods.name: AddOnsFactory.clearAddOnList
methods.description: Clears the current list of add-ons and their mappings.

methods.name: AddOnsFactory.getExternalAddOns
methods.description: Discovers external add-ons via broadcast receivers and package metadata.

methods.name: AddOnsFactory.parseAddOnsFromXml
methods.description: Parses add-on definitions from an XML resource.

methods.name: AddOnsFactory.createAddOnFromXmlAttributes
methods.description: Creates an add-on instance from XML attributes.

methods.name: AddOnsFactory.getApiVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the API version from a package's resources.

methods.name: AddOnsFactory.getAddOnsFromActivityInfo
methods.description: Loads add-ons defined in a package's activity metadata.

methods.name: AddOnsFactory.onExternalPackChanged
methods.description: Handles package change events to refresh add-on list if needed.

methods.name: AddOnsFactory.onConfigurationChanged
methods.description: Updates add-ons with new configuration settings.
